create_udop_processor: create a UDOP processor that combines a LayoutLMv3 image processor and a UDOP tokenizer for document understanding
build_udop_processor_call: build a UDOP processor call with images, text, bounding boxes, and word labels for token classification tasks
test_udop_processor_ocr: test the UDOP processor with OCR enabled images and verify it rejects bounding boxes and word labels when apply_ocr is True
refactor_udop_processor_overflow: refactor the UDOP processor to handle overflowing tokens by mapping each input_ids sample to its corresponding image
review_udop_model_input_names: review the UDOP processor's model_input_names property that combines tokenizer inputs, image processor inputs, and bbox
